title: CrowdStrike Falcon or SentinelOne Singularity: Cloud-Led vs Autonomous EDR
excerpt: Two leading endpoint protection platforms with different philosophies: CrowdStrike leans on central cloud analytics and threat intelligence, while SentinelOne emphasises autonomous detection and response on the device itself.
verdict: CrowdStrike is the safer choice if you want the largest deployment base, the widest pool of experienced staff and mature managed services. SentinelOne is a strong alternative, especially if on-device automated response and built-in ransomware rollback matter to you. Weigh vendor reliability as well as detection: in July 2024 a faulty CrowdStrike content update crashed roughly 8.5 million Windows devices worldwide, a reminder that any agent running with kernel-level privileges needs staged update controls. When vendors quote MITRE ATT&CK Evaluation results, remember that MITRE publishes raw data and does not rank or score products.
